leadText:
David (Japanese: デイビッド David) is a minor character who appeared in Spell of the Unown: Entei. He works as a butler, alongside three other maids, at Spencer Hale's manor.

After Hale disappeared while examining some faraway ruins, David was informed of this by Hale's assistant Schuyler. They were discussing the events when Hale's daughter Molly came into the room, and David volunteered to give her the news.

Later, when Molly first unleashed the , he was forced to flee to the local Pokémon Center as the mansion (and later much of Greenfield) became crystallized.

After and intervened, Molly abandoned her fantasy world, which returned Greenfield back to normal. As a result, David was among those who returned to the Hale household. In the ending credits, David was still seen working at the mansion after Professor Hale's return.
